phases.name: PH1
phases.description: Phase 1 works across CSA trade, including structural steel, steel decking, intumescent protection, secondary steel and associated metalwork in FSA, DCH, EYD, MYD and SSA zones, plus steel-related interfaces with cladding and roofs.
activities: Primary structural steel frame supply and erection to EXC2, S355 (FSA, DCH)
Steel roof decking supply and installation (FSA, DCH, SSA)
Intumescent fire protection to primary steel (FSA, DCH, EYD trenches, MYD gantries)
Secondary steel for cladding support (FSA, DCH)
Holding down bolt assemblies (supply and/or casting‑in interfaces with foundations)
Structural steel for generator trench (EYD)
USS trench and utility structural steel (EYD)
Cooling tower gantry structural steelwork and associated stairs, ladders, railings, gratings (MYD)
Miscellaneous structural / secondary steel items: internal and external stairs, cat ladders, hop‑over steps, crash protection, bollards, railings, grating, loading dock handrails
Steel safety fabrications for assembled roof stairs
Metal roof walkways and roof railings where specified as steel
Louvres and cladding details where secondary steel or steel penetration framing is included
Steel columns kickers/bolts interfaces to EYD slabs
Supply of hold down bolt assemblies for multiple equipment foundations (MCP, ASB, CTB, USS, MUP, S24, S25 etc.)
SSA Load Bank Garage & Fuel Polishing Building structural steel frame, roof deck, railings and cat ladder
SSA cladding and roof elements where directly supported by the SSA steel frame
dependencies: Foundations, slabs and plinths complete with holding down assemblies cast in by others before steel erection (multiple references, e.g. S02-A1500 line 394-395; S02-A1600 line 587-588; EYD foundations Dornan 005 line 731; SSA foundation S02-A1000 line 2029-2030).
Waterproofing, blinding and earthing mat generally preceding steel erection but not part of steel scope.
Cladding and roof composite systems to follow completion of primary and secondary steel frames and roof decking (FSA and DCH envelopes and roofs).
Steel stairs, ladders and railings on cooling tower gantries dependent on gantry primary steel completion (S02-A7200 lines 781-794, 1207-1219, 1599-1613, 1882-1894).
SSA steelworks depend on SSA foundations (S02-A1000 lines 2022-2036).
constraints: Execution Class 2 (EXC2) for structural steel to NBN EN 1090-2, all steel grade S355 (e.g. S03-A2000 lines 452-453, 643-644, 775, 782, 1201, 1600, 175, 773, 1593, 1600, 1876, 1883, 2005).

Intumescent paint fire protection durations defined per zone: 2 h for FSA (line 462), 2 h for DCH PH1 (line 653); 1 h for DCH PH2/PH3/PH4 (lines 1138, 1495, 1814); 60‑min fire protection for EYD generator/USS trench steel (lines 763, 770).
Corrosion protection system C2 environment category for certain trench steels (lines 762, 769).

Galvanizing to EN ISO 1461 for certain external steelwork (cooling tower gantries, SSA steel, MYD supports and gantries; e.g. lines 780, 787, 786, 1212-1213, 1598, 1604-1605, 1880-1881, 1887-1888, 2010).
Interfaces with cladding and roofing requiring coordinated penetrations and secondary steel (FSA/DCH/Shell A cladding and roof sections, e.g. lines 476, 666, 149, 115, 1506, 1825).

Holding down assemblies are free‑issue from structural steel subcontractor but cast in and grouted by civils; grout to be allowed for under concrete sections (e.g. S02-A1500 line 395, S02-A1600 line 588, S02-A1000 Dornan 005 line 731, S02-A7200 supply-only packages lines 1037-1044, 1311-1314, 1710-1712, 1987-1989).

phases.name: PH2
phases.description: Phase 2 expansion works focusing on DCH building and MYD cooling infrastructure, including additional structural steel, decking, intumescent coatings, secondary steel, and steel support to envelopes and roofs.
activities: DCH Phase 2 primary structural steel frame EXC2 S355 with steel decking and intumescent fire protection (1 h) (lines 1127-1138).
Additional DCH external steelwork/metalwork: cat ladders, stairs over roof parapets, bollards, small roof stairs (lines 1139-1143).
Secondary steel to support cladding for DCH PH2 envelope, including base details, penetrations and cat ladders (lines 1145-1157, 1166-1172).
Phase 2 roof systems over DCH with composite Euroclad top deck, parapet steel interfaces, walkways and lightning protection (lines 1183-1198).

MYD PH2 densified cooling area: structural steel gantries, supports for RMUs and battery boxes, with galvanizing and H.D.A. assemblies, plus cat ladders, cooling tower stairs, railings and grating (lines 1199-1219).
Supply‑only hold down bolt assemblies and steel steps/ramps with handrails for modular cooling plant and USS foundations (lines 1311-1318).
Safety fabrications at roof level (supports for assembled stair) under External Windows & Doors PH2 (line 1315-1317 indirectly referencing roof stair supports).
dependencies: Completion of DCH PH2 foundations and slabs including H.D.A. casting and earthing mat (lines 1045-1126) prior to Phase 2 steelwork.
Cooling tower gantry PH2 foundations/plinths (S02-A1100 lines 1220-1236) to precede gantry structural steel (S02-A7200 lines 1207-1214).
MCP and USS foundations PH2 to be complete with H.D.A. in place and coordinated with supply of hold down bolt assemblies from S02-A7200 (lines 1256-1274, 1237-1255, 1311-1318).
Roof envelope and lightning protection PH2 follow completion of steel deck and primary roof steel framing (lines 1183-1198, 1185-1186).
constraints: Structural steel to EXC2 and S355 with erection per NSSSBC 5th Edition (lines 1128-1129, 1201, 1208).
Intumescent coating 1 h to all DCH PH2 primary steel (line 1138).
Galvanized finish for PH2 cooling tower gantry steel to EN ISO 1461 (lines 1212-1213).
Steel deck profile TATA D60x1.2mm as standard for DCH PH2 (line 1132).
Coordination of holding down bolt assemblies supply (S02-A7200) with civil contractor’s casting program.
Roof and envelope interfaces requiring continuity of fire and weather seals at steel penetrations and cat ladders (lines 1158-1165, 1187-1191).

phases.name: PH3
phases.description: Phase 3 works extending CSA/DCH/MYD/EYD structures, including additional DCH primary and secondary steel, MYD/EYD cooling steelwork, and associated roof and envelope steel elements.
activities: DCH Phase 3 structural steel frame EXC2 S355 with steel decking and intumescent fire protection (1 h) (lines 1484-1495).
DCH Phase 3 miscellaneous steel items: external stair (ground to roof) and bollards (lines 1496-1500).
DCH Phase 3 secondary steel to envelope cladding including base details, cover flashings, cat ladders, downpipes accessories and fire barriers (lines 1501-1523).
DCH Phase 3 roof systems over DCH with composite Euroclad top deck, parapet upstands, roof walkways, lightning protection, and roof penetrations (lines 1540-1555).

MYD Phase 3 densified water‑cooled areas: cooling tower gantry structural steel plus supports for RMUs & battery boxes, with galvanizing, cat ladders, emergency stairs, railings, bumpers and open mesh grating (lines 1591-1613, 1599-1613, 1601-1605, 1613).
Cooling tower gantry PH3 pad foundations and hold down assemblies coordinated with steel (lines 1614-1633).
EYD Phase 3: structural steel interfaces via “steel columns kickers/bolts” to foundations and USS plinths for later steel columns (S02-A1000 lines 1562-1573).
Supply of hold down bolt assemblies and steel steps/ramps with handrails for modular cooling plant and USS at PH3 (lines 1709-1716).
Safety fabrications supports for assembled stair at roof level (PH3) under External Windows & Doors (line 1537-1539).
dependencies: Completion of DCH PH3 foundations/slabs including H.D.A. cast‑ins (S02-A1600 lines 1399-1452) before DCH PH3 steel frames and decking (lines 1484-1490).

Cooling tower gantry PH3 foundations (S02-A1100 lines 1614-1633) and USS/MCP/S25/USS Trestle foundations (lines 1634-1689) required before corresponding gantry and support steel (S02-A7200 lines 1591-1613 and 1601-1606).
EYD PH3 slabs and plinths including steel column kickers/bolts (lines 1556-1574) must be in place prior to erection of associated superstructure steel supplied in other packages.
Roof envelopes and lightning protection follow completion of steel deck and primary framing (lines 1540-1555).
constraints: Structural steel to EXC2 S355; erection per NSSSBC 5th Edition (lines 1485-1486, 1593, 1600).
Intumescent paint 1 h protection for DCH PH3 primary steel (line 1495).
Galvanizing to EN ISO 1461 for MYD PH3 gantry and support steel (lines 1604-1605, 1598).
Standard deck profile TATA D60x1.2mm on DCH PH3 (line 1489).
Open mesh grating 30 mm depth for platforms and walkways on gantries (lines 1612, 1613).
Requirement to grout steel bases and H.D.A. (DCH additional items lines 1480-1483).

phases.name: PH4
phases.description: Phase 4 finalisation of DCH building structural steel, decking, envelopes and associated MYD cooling steel infrastructure.
activities: DCH Phase 4 structural steel frame EXC2 S355 with deck and 1 h intumescent fire protection (lines 1803-1814).
DCH Phase 4 additional external steelwork: cat ladders and balustrades, bollards, stairs over roof parapets, small roof stairs (lines 1815-1819).
DCH Phase 4 secondary steel to envelope cladding, including base details and secondary steel grids (lines 1821-1827).
DCH Phase 4 composite roof systems with parapet upstands, roof walkways, lightning protection and roof penetrations (lines 1857-1872).
MYD Phase 4 cooling infrastructure: Shell A structural steel for supports and cooling tower gantries, with galvanizing, H.D.A., stairs, cat ladders, railings and grating (lines 1873-1894).
Cooling tower gantry PH4 foundations and USS/MCP/S25/USS Trestle foundations for PH4, each with H.D.A. cast‑ins coordinated to steel (lines 1895-1985).
Supply of hold down bolt assemblies for MCP, USS, S25 foundations and additional steel steps and ramps with handrails (lines 1986-1993).
dependencies: DCH PH4 foundations and slabs including H.D.A. (S02-A1600 lines 1717-1788; S02-A1200 lines 1789-1797) must be complete before DCH PH4 steel (lines 1803-1809).
Cooling tower gantry PH4 foundations (S02-A1100 lines 1895-1911) and USS/MCP/S25/USS Trestle foundations (lines 1912-1985) precede respective gantry steel (S02-A7200 lines 1882-1889).
Roof deck and envelope PH4 over DCH installed after primary steel and decking (lines 1857-1872).
constraints: Structural steel to EXC2, S355, erected to NSSSBC 5th Edition (lines 1804-1805, 1876, 1883).
Intumescent paint 1 h for DCH PH4 primary steel (line 1814).
Galvanizing to EN ISO 1461 for MYD PH4 Shell A structural steel (lines 1887-1888, 1880-1881).
TATA D60x1.2mm deck on DCH PH4 roofs (line 1808).
Grouting of steel bases at multiple foundations (e.g. 1802, 1902-1903).

zones.name: CSA (global)
zones.description: Civil/structural area code used across the project to denote structural works packages; includes all building zones (FSA, DCH, EYD, MYD, SSA) where CSA appears with structural steel scope.
activities: Coordination of structural steel design and execution class (EXC2 S355).
Provision of holding down assemblies and grout in coordination with concrete works.
Global procurement of steel deck profiles TATA D60x1.2mm and similar.
Global management of intumescent fire protection systems (1h/2h).
Secondary steel for cladding and roof interfaces across zones.
zones.logistics: CSA tag ties BOQ lines back to structural general notes and details; no explicit logistics noted, but CSA packages span multiple buildings and require phased erection aligned with foundations and envelope works.

zones.name: FSA
zones.description: Main facility structure A (likely data hall or support building). Structural steel framing, decking, and envelope are broken out separately by phase where relevant.
activities: Primary structural steel frame FSA Structural Steel (S03-A2000 line 454).
Steel deck to FSA roof (S05-A2000 lines 455-457).
Intumescent paint 2 h for FSA primary steel (line 462).

Miscellaneous internal stair (FSA) and external steelwork/metalwork (loading dock fencing, handrails, crash protection, cat ladder and balustrade to penthouse, bollards, hop‑over steps) (lines 464-470).
Secondary steel for FSA envelope cladding (line 476).
Composite roof system over FSA with Euroclad top deck, parapet upstands, walkways and lightning protection (lines 536-556).
SSA interface: FSA AOVs on roof (line 2069).
zones.logistics: FSA steel erection must follow FSA foundations/floor slabs (S02-A1500 block) and precede envelope and roof works (S04-A2100 FSA, S05-A2000 FSA). Coordination with load bank garage (SSA) and cooling infrastructures via connecting stairs, walkways and railings.
zones.source: FSA structural and envelope lines at [451-471], [536-556], [360-420], [2069-2071]

zones.name: DCH
zones.description: Data Center Hall (DCH) buildings with multi‑phase foundations, structural steel, decks, cladding and roof systems.
activities: PH1: DCH Structural Steel, deck, 2 h intumescent, external stair, cat ladders (FSA to DCH roof and ground to roof), bollards, hop‑over steps; secondary steel to cladding and roof (lines 642-660, 661-695, 709-724).

PH2: Additional DCH Structural Steel and deck, 1 h intumescent, cat ladder, parapet stairs, small stairs, bollards; secondary steel for enlarged envelope and roof Phase 2 (lines 1127-1143, 1145-1172, 1183-1198).
PH3: Further DCH structural steel and deck, 1 h intumescent; external stairs, bollards; secondary steel and cladding/roof for PH3 envelope (lines 1484-1499, 1501-1528, 1540-1555).

PH4: Final DCH structural steel, deck and 1 h intumescent; additional external ladders, bollards and roof/parapet stairs; final cladding and roof steel interfaces (lines 1803-1819, 1821-1835, 1857-1872).
zones.logistics: DCH structure built over multiple phases; each phase’s foundations and slabs with holding down assemblies (S02-A1600, S02-A1200) must be ready before corresponding PHx steel. Roof deck and envelope track with steel by phase and require access coordination for cat ladders and roof stairs between FSA and DCH roofs.

zones.name: EYD
zones.description: Electrical Yard or similar external zone with large foundation slabs and trenches for generator and USS equipment, including local structural steel interfaces.
activities: PH1: Generator trench structural steel and USS trench structural steel, including corrosion protection C2, 60‑min intumescent coating in factory, touch‑up after erection and holding down bolts (supply only) (lines 759-772).
PH1: Steel columns kickers/bolts cast into EYD foundation slab (Dornan 005 line 731, 742).
PH3: Similar EYD configuration with steel columns kickers/bolts and interfaces to USS plinths for later steel frames (lines 1562-1574).
zones.logistics: EYD structural steel for trenches depends on EYD foundation slabs and plinths (S02-A1000 Dornan 001-007 etc.). Steel items are largely factory‑finished with limited site works (touch‑up and bolt installation). Access from perimeter for trench steel installation must be coordinated with yard concrete.

zones.name: MYD
zones.description: Mechanical Yard / cooling yard areas associated with water‑cooled systems and cooling tower gantries.
activities: PH1: MYD densified yard concrete (out of scope) with associated structural steel gantry and support packages defined later; Fuel Oil Offloading Areas at MYD with steel interfaces via hold down assemblies and bollards (lines 165-206, 186-206).
PH1: Cooling Tower Gantry structural steel Shell A 537 t (approx) with H.D.A., galvanizing, emergency stairs, cat ladders, railings and open mesh grating (lines 781-795, 786-787, 790-794).

PH2: Cooling Tower Gantry structural steel Shell A 377 t plus support steel for RMUs & battery boxes (0.56 t) with galvanizing, H.D.A., cat ladders, cooling tower stairs, railings and grating (lines 1199-1219, 1207-1214).

PH3: Cooling Tower Gantry structural steel Shell A 385 t + RMU supports 0.56 t, with galvanizing, H.D.A., cat ladders, emergency stairs, railings, bumper railings and grating (lines 1591-1613, 1601-1606, 1607-1613).

PH4: Cooling Tower Gantry structural steel Shell A 249 t + RMU supports 0.38 t, with galvanizing, H.D.A., cat ladders, cooling tower stairs, railings and grating (lines 1873-1894, 1882-1889, 1890-1894).
zones.logistics: MYD cooling tower gantries require substantial foundations (S02-A1100 groups for cooling tower gantry and various trestle/pad foundations) completed before steel erection. Gantries carry stairs and walkways for access; erection sequencing must coordinate with mechanical equipment installation and with EYD / USS trenches. Galvanizing and open‑mesh grating imply off‑site fabrication and minimal field welding.

zones.name: SSA
zones.description: Separate SSA scope including Load Bank Garage & Fuel Polishing Building, plus additional FSA AHU foundations and site development items tied to structural steel.
activities: SSA Load Bank Garage & Fuel Polishing Building structural steel frame (Shell A) EXC2 S355 with H.D.A., galvanizing, surface touch‑up and associated roof decking and rail/ladder system (lines 2003-2015).
SSA roof deck: Kingspan RD 100/825 roof deck single spanning 1.5 mm gauge, roof railings and cat ladder (lines 2012-2015).
SSA envelope cladding: 240 mm Rockspan panels, parapet capping, scuppers, hoppers and downpipes, rolling shutter; all dependent on SSA steel frame (lines 2016-2021).
SSA site development: cycle route asphalt – no direct steel; only coordination with SSA foundations and entrance steel (line 2040-2041).
SSA additional FSA AHU foundation with H.D.A. and generator flue HDBA interfaces to steel (lines 2042-2061).
zones.logistics: SSA steel erection contingent on SSA foundations (S02-A1000 lines 2022-2036) and AHU foundations (S02-A1300 lines 2042-2061). Roof railings and cat ladders must coordinate with SSA roof deck and cladding penetrations. Access via SSA yard/roads is implied by site development items.

zones.name: RSA
zones.description: Security Fence & Infrastructure zone, primarily non‑structural, but includes metal security fencing posts that may be anchored to foundations or steelwork.
activities: 3 m high chainlink security fence on metal posts (line 1997).
Associated gates and fencing to attenuation pond (timber – not steel; interface with site boundaries).
zones.logistics: Security fence likely installed near end of PH1 after major steel erection and heavy logistics are complete, to avoid obstruction of crane access. Metal posts require coordination with any steel bollards or barrier rails near entrances.

included: All items directly impacting structural steel tonnage, fabrication, supply, erection, corrosion protection (paint, galvanizing), intumescent fire protection, metal decking, secondary steel, metal stairs, ladders, railings, gratings and steel interfaces such as holding down assemblies and grout to steel bases.
Phase/zone relationships for all structural‑steel‑related work packages across FSA, DCH, MYD, EYD, SSA and RSA.
excluded: All pure concrete, blinding, rebar, formwork, membranes and general civil works without explicit steel interface, in line with instruction to ignore concrete scope.
Architectural windows, doors, finishes and non‑structural trades without direct steel interface.

interfaces_highlights: Holding down assemblies (H.D.A.) are repeatedly defined as free issue from the structural steel subcontractor but cast into concrete by others across multiple zones and phases (e.g. S02-A1500 line 395; S02-A1600 line 588; S02-A1100 & S02-A1000 groups; S02-A7200 supply‑only lines).

Intumescent protection durations vary by building and phase: FSA generally 2 h, DCH up to 2 h in PH1 and 1 h in later phases, trench steels 60 min; this drives paint system selection and DFT requirements.

Cooling Tower Gantry systems in MYD involve large primary steel, extensive galvanized platforms with open mesh grating, and significant access steel (stairs, ladders, railings) across PH1–PH4; coordination with mechanical cooling plant and access/egress is critical.
Secondary steel for cladding (S04-A2100) is substantial for both FSA and DCH and must coordinate with primary frames, roof decks and penetrations for services, canopies and ladders.
